_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for mapping any agent's plan_ast tool names to the guardians/cedar canonical vocabulary. Covers Claude Code names (Read/Write/Bash/WebFetch), codex names (shell/edit/view), and free-form plan prose (readFile/curlPost). A `read` bucket resolves to read_secret vs read_repo_file by path. compute/noop are benign pass-throughs (in allowed_tools, no source/sink). Update HERE, both guardians (_toolmap.py) and cedar (run-cedar-plan.js) pick it up.
_note_canonical: Each canonical name self-aliases so a grounded plan that already uses the registry vocabulary passes through unchanged (not re-bucketed).
_arg_comment: Per-canonical-tool arg-name mapping so the guardians taint SINK params match regardless of the agent's arg naming (curlPost data -> network_send.body). Left of ':' is the policy param; the list is the aliases the agent might use.
